name: ChatGPT
description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's chat assistant. You describe what you need in plain language and it replies in text, which people use for drafts, outlines, explanations and ideas.
features: Chat-based assistant for writing, analysis and questions
useCases: Turning rough notes into a first draft of an email or proposal
Explaining an unfamiliar topic in simpler words
strengths: Handles many writing and thinking tasks in one place
Widely used, so many tutorials and guides exist
limitations: Can state wrong facts confidently, so check anything important
Do not paste confidential client or personal information unless you are allowed to

free.details: Free plan: unlimited text chats (subject to abuse guardrails) with limited uploads, image creation, voice chats, deep research and memory.

plans.name: Free
limits: Limited uploads, image creation, voice chats, deep research and memory

plans.name: Go
plans.note: Billed monthly. Displayed as PKR 1,400 per month for a Pakistan visitor; the USD price was not shown. The page says this plan may include ads.
highlights: More messages, uploads, image creation and voice chats than Free
May include ads (the page says so)

plans.name: Plus
plans.billing: $20 per month, billed monthly. The help center says annual billing is not offered.
highlights: Expanded messages, uploads, deep research and memory
Projects, scheduled tasks and custom GPTs
plans.note: Displayed as PKR 5,700 per month for a Pakistan visitor; the USD $20 figure is from an earlier check and was not re-seen in this browser.

plans.name: Pro 100
highlights: Pro reasoning models and longer Codex sessions
plans.note: Pro has three usage tiers. For a Pakistan visitor the page showed 'From PKR 27,999 per month'; USD tier prices are from an earlier check.

plans.name: Business
plans.note: Priced per user, starting at 2 users, with monthly and annual options. The price was not captured.

api.summary: API usage is billed separately from ChatGPT plans.

pricing.regional: Purchases are made in USD; local-currency billing exists in a limited set of countries (OpenAI help center). Tax may apply.
notes: The pricing page showed plan names and features but did not display price figures in the text we could read; Plus and Pro prices come from the official OpenAI help center.
Educational and non-profit discounts exist; see the pricing page FAQ.

sources.label: OpenAI help center: What is ChatGPT Plus?
OpenAI help center: About ChatGPT Pro tiers

verification.notes: Product active. The pricing page opened for a Pakistan visitor in rupees: Free PKR 0, Go PKR 1,400/month, Plus PKR 5,700/month, Pro from PKR 27,999/month (three usage tiers). Business and Enterprise sit on a separate tab that was not read. The USD figures kept here ($20 Plus; $100/$200/$500 Pro tiers) come from an earlier check and were not shown in this browser, so they stay partially verified.

profile.headline: One assistant to chat, work and code in

capabilities.title: Get help with everyday questions
capabilities.text: Explain concepts, draft messaging, search the web, compare options and think through a decision.

capabilities.title: Turn rough notes into polished writing
capabilities.text: Draft messages, notes, plans, stories and posts, and keep editing as your thinking develops.

capabilities.title: Finish work tasks start to finish
capabilities.text: ChatGPT Work can create and edit docs, slide decks, spreadsheets, charts, PDFs and other deliverables using the tools and apps you already use.

capabilities.title: Write, test and review code
capabilities.text: Codex is the coding agent that sits alongside ChatGPT, from understanding and planning to writing, testing, reviewing and shipping code.

featureCards.name: Chat
featureCards.text: The everyday mode: questions, learning, ideas and web search.

featureCards.name: ChatGPT Work
featureCards.text: Creates and edits documents, decks, spreadsheets and charts from your own files and apps.

featureCards.name: Codex
featureCards.text: A coding agent for understanding a project and for writing, debugging and reviewing code.

featureCards.name: Images
featureCards.text: Create images from a prompt, explore visual directions, or generate graphic designs for flyers and branding.

featureCards.name: Voice
featureCards.text: Talk with ChatGPT in real time to brainstorm, practise or learn when speaking is easier than typing.

featureCards.name: Connected work apps
featureCards.text: Connect to internal files and apps such as Gmail and Slack to build deliverables and automate tasks.

featureCards.name: Privacy and safety controls
featureCards.text: You choose how your data is used, and Parental Controls let parents set safeguards for teen users.

audienceDetail.text: Chat is described as being for questions, learning and everyday help.
ChatGPT Work is for completing work tasks, with Business and Enterprise plans for organisations.
Codex covers coding and technical work.
Parental Controls are offered for teen users.

scenarios.title: Draft a plan from rough notes
scenarios.text: Paste your thoughts and ask for a clear, polished version you can keep editing.

scenarios.title: Build a deck or spreadsheet from your own files
scenarios.text: Use ChatGPT Work with the apps you already use to produce the finished document.

scenarios.title: Debug code or learn a project
scenarios.text: Write, debug and improve code, or ask how a software project works.

scenarios.title: Make a flyer or branding visual
scenarios.text: Describe the design and explore visual directions before you settle on one.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Try ChatGPT button on the site, or download the app.
The site notes that the new experience is available to all plans on macOS and Windows desktop, and to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu on web and mobile.
ChatGPT is offered in plans for personal use and for business and enterprise.
Decide how your data may be used from the privacy controls.
